$comment: THE reviewed list of game hero photographs (one per team identity and era). A pin is added only after a person has looked at the full frame and confirmed it shows THIS home team's identity (its end zones / centre-ice / court logo / signage) at THIS venue — not merely the right building. Candidates come from the contact sheets of scripts/heroes/candidates.mjs; scripts/heroes/fetch.mjs turns each pin into the served files (public/heroes/<sport>/<id>-{2400,1200,720}.webp) and src/lib/hero/photos.json, with the licence read from Commons itself.

focus: CSS object-position for the desktop band and for phones. from/to: [from, to) dates the frame represents (a branding or configuration era). neutralOk: the frame may stand for the venue at a neutral-site game. review: who checked what, when.
